correctness.rationale: For odd q and nonsingular symmetric S(4×4), direct sp8 block multiplication reduces X²=[X,N_S]=0 to C=0, AS+SA^T=0, A²=0, AB=BA^T with symmetric B. When A=0, symmetric B rank-r strata give the four-degree rank polynomial and q^10 total. For A≠0, skew-adjointness makes rank(A) even and A²=0 makes rank≤2; its image is a maximal totally isotropic plane. Nonsplit quadratic four-spaces admit none; split ones have 2(q+1) such planes with q−1 nonzero A each. In a Witt-adapted basis AB=BA^T gives six linear degrees of freedom in symmetric B, and the resulting X always has rank four. Hence split adds 2(q²−1)q⁶ z⁴, nonsplit adds zero, for every odd prime power. Independent exhaustive F3 skew-A enumeration found 16 split/0 nonsplit, with compatible B kernel dimension 6. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the Witt/linear algebra proof.
